name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

topics.title: 课程作业
topics.summary: 遵守具体课程教师书面AI政策。教师选择政策并须书面通知学生；Registry的大纲表述为should，不升为must。未经授权的辅助及伪造事实或引用仍属不端。
topics.scope: 自2023–24学年秋季学期起以课程具体规定为准；教务处大纲建议（should）与CEI书面通知要求（requirement）有所区分。

claims.text: HKUST faculty may set course-level GenAI rules and must communicate the selected option to students in writing for courses offered from Fall 2023-24.

evidence.quote:
Given the evolving landscape of GenAI tools, HKUST allows faculty members the flexibility to set their own
          course-level policies. Faculty members are required to communicate the chosen policy option to students in writing
          for courses offered starting Fall 2023-24.
evidence.title: Guidelines and Policies | Center for Education Innovation

claims.text: HKUST assessment guidance says course syllabi should clearly state relevant GenAI and academic-integrity policies and be available at the start of a course; CEI separately requires faculty to communicate their chosen GenAI policy in writing.

topics.title: 考试
topics.summary: 考试条件下的规则要求电子设备及AI智能眼镜置于不可取用处，除非明确许可；论文及毕业项目考核不在该考试规则范围，仍须看具体说明。
topics.scope: 考试条件下的测验与考核；明确排除学位论文、毕业设计项目或类似考核。

claims.text: Under HKUST exam-condition rules, electronic and communication devices, including AI-enabled smart glasses, must be placed beyond access unless expressly permitted; thesis and final-year-project assessments are excluded from these rules.

evidence.quote: 3. Except for items explicitly permitted for an examination, all books, bags, papers, and electronic/communication devices*, etc. must be placed ideally at the front, rear or side of the venue so that they cannot be accessed. These items may be placed under desks and seats only where they are easily visible and with an invigilator’s permission.

topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.summary: 避免输入保密、敏感和个人资料。商业工具中校内保密文件的去敏说明不等于个人资料普遍可上传。Open WebUI聊天历史标明30天，其他日志和服务商留存未确立。
topics.scope: 商业工具文档与通用隐私警示；Open WebUI历史记录留存期以该服务特定规则为准。

claims.text: HKUST advises against using confidential university documents in commercial GenAI unless desensitized; separately, it instructs users to avoid inputting confidential, sensitive or personal data and to comply with data-protection law.

evidence.quote: Most of the commercial generative AI tools have stated that users’ submitted data may be used for training and product enhancement.  Users are advised not to use confidential HKUST documents in those tools unless they are desensitized.

topics.title: 研究与发表
topics.summary: 研究诚信与学位相关学生不端走不同程序。UROP报告可咨询AI但不能由AI完成最终撰写，仍须遵守导师及研究隐私伦理要求。
topics.scope: 大学相关研究；单独的学位不端行为规则；UROP特定的最终撰写限制。

claims.text: HKUST research-integrity rules govern university-related scholarly work, while student plagiarism related to university awards follows academic-integrity regulations; research data must follow privacy and ethical rules.

evidence.quote: This Policy applies to all faculty, staff and students, as well as visiting researchers and affiliated researchers, in regard to research or scholarly inquiry undertaken at or on behalf of the University, regardless of the funding source.

additionalTopics.summary: 未经授权的辅助和伪造可触发学生纪律程序。成绩公布后10工作日申请，接受的复核在公布后15工作日内安排；收到部门决定后10工作日向Dean申诉。纪律申诉另按书面通知日期14日历日起算。

claims.text: Appeal a course-grade-review decision to the School/AIS Dean within 10 working days after receipt of the departmental decision; appeals generally require procedural irregularity or justified new evidence. This is separate from misconduct appeals.

evidence.quote: Requests for review of course grades should normally be resolved at the Department/unit level.  Students who wish to appeal against the decision of the department/unit must do so in writing to the School Dean/AIS Dean within ten working days of receiving the decision, stating the grounds for the appeal. Appeals shall generally be considered only on the basis of procedural irregularity and/or new evidence, accompanied by a justification for the failure to submit this evidence to the Head of department during the initial stage of grade review.

additionalTopics.title: 教学指导
additionalTopics.summary: 教师制定并沟通课程AI政策。CEI建议不要仅依赖AI检测器，应调整考核设计；这不是全校禁用检测器。受限指南和报告全文仍未取得。
additionalTopics.scope: CEI公开教学指引；未调取或推定SSO指南全文。

claims.text: HKUST faculty may set course-level GenAI rules and must communicate the selected option to students in writing for courses offered from Fall 2023-24.

evidence.quote:
Given the evolving landscape of GenAI tools, HKUST allows faculty members the flexibility to set their own
          course-level policies. Faculty members are required to communicate the chosen policy option to students in writing
          for courses offered starting Fall 2023-24.
evidence.title: Guidelines and Policies | Center for Education Innovation

claims.text: HKUST CEI recommends designing assessments that account for GenAI instead of relying solely on AI-text detectors; the guidance is not an institutional ban on detectors.

evidence.quote: Faculty members have raised concerns about integrating AI tools, such as ChatGPT, into assessment activities and identifying student-generated, machine-generated, or student/machine-generated content. However, CEI believes that solely relying on AI detection tools to detect AI-generated content in students’ output is not the best solution, as technology advances quickly and AI detection tools often lag the advancement of Generative AI. Instead of focusing all efforts on finding a bulletproof AI detection tool, we recommend that you shift your focus to reviewing your assessment design.
evidence.title: Assessment Design | CEI

claims.text: HKUST advises against using confidential university documents in commercial GenAI unless desensitized; separately, it instructs users to avoid inputting confidential, sensitive or personal data and to comply with data-protection law.

evidence.quote: Most of the commercial generative AI tools have stated that users’ submitted data may be used for training and product enhancement.  Users are advised not to use confidential HKUST documents in those tools unless they are desensitized.
